scope: HF byte identity, selected-field correctness, software and numerical verification; no cosmological hypothesis test

selection.planck: All 1653 rows; lii,bii in Galactic degrees; value=snr (dimensionless detection SNR, not temperature). Preserve original order and a name-to-row sidecar.
selection.sunspots: Calendar year 2019, date ascending; 365 unique consecutive days; t=UTC days since 2019-01-01; value=sunspot_number; all numeric values must match primary SILSO. Preserve other columns in raw Parquet and sidecar. Exclude disputed is_provisional from engine input.

nonblockingForSelectedFieldsOnly: is_provisional metadata mismatch, retained as an explicit source-semantic failure
